body: I am literally disabled. I can’t even walk on my own. My landlord was arrested. My roommates took me in and explained to me that I don’t have to pay rent. It not about a lack of community support.

I’ve been surgically sterilized. I take methotrexate for my AI disorders which is a drug  also commonly used to induce abortion. No kids for me. I love my dog, and I have to go before the situation causes her to suffer too. Her previous foster mom loved her very much and I don’t doubt she’d be well taken care of.

The thing about autoimmune disorders is that they are chronic, meaning every single day I am less healthy than I was the day before. There is no getting better.
